name: Disclosure and expansion
when: Use only when an evidenced disclosure interaction needs feedback or continuity; optional motion is not a product requirement.
problem: Help users connect a revealed explanation or filter region with its trigger.
animate: Rotate a small disclosure indicator or fade revealed content; prefer native details when sufficient.
stable: Keep trigger identity, focus and scroll position stable; let document flow adapt without animating arbitrary height.
easing: Prefer ease-out for arrivals; ease-in for departures; keep direct manipulation immediate.
accessibility: Keep keyboard focus visible and semantics/live feedback independent of animation; essential actions must remain immediately usable.
reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, remove spatial movement and looping effects; retain an instant state change and textual feedback.
performance: Prefer opacity/transform on small elements; avoid per-frame layout, large blur/repaint regions and permanent will-change hints.
avoid: Avoid large height tweens, nested accordion motion and delayed access to revealed controls.
